nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=70 beats='Wren finds a thirty-third chess piece in a junk-shop set; the extra rook has a tiny fox on its base; Mrs Harlow says the set came from Penrose House.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='At Penrose House Wren meets caretaker Mr Nye; the dusty hall smells of old paper; the fox mark matches the sign above the Bowe workshop.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Mr Nye leads Wren to a locked cabinet; inside is a receipt from the Bowe workshop dated 1927; the extra rook was meant for a ship.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='The old Bowe workshop is now a tea shop; the owner keeps the fox sign in the window; Wren sees a wooden queen with the same mark.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='In the town library the archivist finds a 1927 newspaper; it tells of Tomas Bowe carving chess sets for the steamer Meridian.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Mrs Bowe shows Wren a family chest; inside is a carved queen with a fox and a name scratched underneath: Tomas.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='At the harbor office a ledger lists the Meridian cargo; one line says one crate of chess sets for Bellhaven.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The dockmaster says the Meridian hit a storm and sank; divers brought up a broken chess table stained with salt.'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='The salvage yard holds the broken table; its fox stamp matches the extra rook; Wren must decide whether to dig deeper or follow the paper trail.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The salvage owner finds a bill of sale for the table; it names a collector in Bellhaven who bought the Meridian chess sets.'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='At the lighthouse a keeper diary describes saving a crate from the wreck; inside were two chess sets, one with an extra piece.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Seaside Hall hosts a chess club; a framed tournament photo shows a row of players and a wooden rook with a fox on the table.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='The photo caption names the player as Mr Elm of Bellhaven; Wren writes the address in a notebook.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='The Bellhaven Museum has a trunk from the Elm family; the curator opens it and finds a matching rook, but not the extra piece.'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='In museum storage Wren compares the extra rook to the Elm rook; the carving is older and the fox faces the other way.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='A reconstructed carver workshop holds Tomas Bowe tools; every handle has a fox mark and a hidden drawer under the bench.'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='Behind the drawer Wren finds a letter from Tomas to his sister; it tells of carving an extra piece for the Elm Street house.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='The letter gives an Elm Street address; Wren leaves the museum and rides a bus across town to the old house.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Elm Street house is now a boarding house; Miss Ada shows Wren a chess cabinet with carved corners and the missing set inside.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=70 beats='Miss Ada says the cabinet came from the Yarrow family auction; the Yarrows owned a clock shop on Market Street.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='Mr Yarrow keeps a tidy antique shop; when Wren shows the extra rook, he goes pale and says the piece is a copy.'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='A photo on the wall shows a Yarrow chess set with a fox rook; the extra piece matches exactly, even the tiny chip on the ear.'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='Mr Yarrow admits his great-aunt lost the set in a bet; he hid the extra piece in a junk-shop lot to keep it safe.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=70 beats='Back at the Harlow shop Mrs Harlow listens to the whole trail; she laughs and says the mystery piece now belongs to Wren.'>>
<<FILL role=climax words=70 beats='Wren holds the fox rook in the shop window light; the collector, the family, and the museum all wait for an answer.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='Wren holds a magnifying glass over the extra rook; the fox tail curves into the initials TB; the wood feels older than the rest.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='Mrs Harlow tells how a tall man sold the chess set from a blue case; he mentioned Penrose House.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='In the Penrose hall Wren finds a pencil note under the radiators; it says Bowe workshop delivered one extra rook.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='Mr Nye recalls the old carver who delivered the set; the man had a fox shaped birthmark on his hand.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='The receipt in the cabinet is faded; it lists one set plus one extra piece for the Meridian captain.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='Wren asks Mr Nye about the ship; he points to a harbor map framed beside the stairs.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='Behind the tea counter is a drawer of old receipts; one shows a fox stamp and the name T Bowe.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='The tea shop owner tells Wren that the Bowe family still lives on Cedar Lane; she draws a small map.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='The librarian lets Wren copy the 1927 article; it names the Meridian and lists the crew.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='The archive card gives the Bowe cottage address; Wren tucks it into the notebook.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='Inside the chest Wren finds a ship ticket for Tomas Bowe; the paper is soft and smells of salt.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='Mrs Bowe grandson tells Wren that Tomas sailed to Bellhaven and never came back; he gives her a button from his coat.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='The cargo page shows the Meridian left on October 3; the chess crate was marked for Bellhaven Museum.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='The dockmaster points to a faded storm warning from 1927; the date matches the Meridian sailing.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='Wren lifts a canvas in the salvage yard; underneath is the fox stamped chess table, split in half.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='The salvage owner says the crate was sold to a Bellhaven collector with silver glasses; he checks his notebook.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='Wren traces the fox carving on the table with a pencil; the rubbing matches the extra rook exactly.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='The salvage owner finds the bill of sale; it names the collector as Mr Pike of Bellhaven.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='Wren phones the Bellhaven collector; he says he sold the Meridian chess sets to a lighthouse museum.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='The address on the bill is the old lighthouse keeper house; Wren bikes along the shore road.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='The keeper diary has a tide chart with a circle around the wreck; Wren marks it in her notebook.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='In the crate Wren finds a torn chess board square with a fox mark; it fits the extra rook base.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='Under the tournament photo Wren reads the date and the name Mr Elm; the rook on the table is clearly the extra piece.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='The chess club archivist says Mr Elm lived on Bellhaven Hill; he gives Wren an old key to the museum.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='The museum curator answers the phone; she says a trunk from the Elm family arrived in 1989.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='Wren studies the map; Bellhaven Hill is two train stops from the harbor.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='The curator opens the trunk and lifts out a worn chess board; the corners match the Harlow set.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='Wren searches the trunk lining and finds a paper label from the Bowe workshop.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='The light shows the extra rook has a chip on one ear; the same chip appears in the museum photo.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='The donation ledger records the Elm set from a Yarrow estate; the penmanship is elegant and old.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='Every tool handle in the workshop has a fox stamp; the chisel edges match the undercut on the rook base.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='Wren knocks on the workbench; one panel sounds hollow, and a drawer slides open.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='The letter signature is Tomas Bowe; the final line says the extra piece was carved for his sister Ada.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='The letter date is October 1, 1927, two days before the Meridian sailed; Wren feels the trail come together.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='The museum caretaker knows Elm Street; he writes the bus number on a scrap of paper.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='A neighbor on Elm Street says Miss Ada kept the old chess cabinet after the Yarrow auction.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='The chess cabinet is unlocked; inside sits a set with the fox rook missing from its row.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='Miss Ada tells Wren that the cabinet was bought from the Yarrow family clock shop; she has the old receipt.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='The city directory lists Yarrow Antiques at 14 Market Street; Wren circles the address.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='At the Yarrow shop a brass bell rings; Mr Yarrow looks up from a clock and frowns.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='The Yarrow ledger has an entry for a chess set sold to a junk dealer; the date is last Tuesday.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='The assistant whispers that Mr Yarrow kept a family photo hidden in the back room.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='The photo shows the Yarrow chess set complete with a fox rook; Wren lays the extra piece beside it.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='A portrait of Great Aunt Ada shows her holding a chess piece with a fox; the family resemblance is clear.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='Mr Yarrow finds his great aunt will; it says the chess set was left to her but lost in a bet.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='Mr Yarrow shakes Wren hand and tells the whole story; he gives her the original box for the piece.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='Mrs Harlow writes Wren a note confirming the find; she pins it to the chess set box.'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=75 beats='Mrs Harlow says the original price was four pounds; she laughs and gives Wren the change.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=75 beats='Wren wraps the extra rook in soft cloth and places it in Mr Yarrow hands; the family story is complete.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=75 beats='Wren slides the rook into a coat pocket to hide it from the collector; the shop bell rings behind her.'>>
<<FILL role=transition words=75 beats='Wren writes a museum label for the fox rook and sets it in a glass case with Tomas Bowe name.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='The rubbing and the table prove the extra piece is real; Wren places the rook back in the set and the set feels complete.'>>

ending.title: The Fox Rook Finds a Player

nodes.body: <<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='The bill of sale names Mr Pike; Wren visits him and learns the extra piece was made for a ship captain, but the trail twists beyond this clue.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='The tide chart leads to a sunken cabin; Wren finds a crate but it holds only broken chessmen, no fox rook; the mystery waits for another day.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='The torn board square fits the rook base; Mrs Harlow says it is the missing square from the Harlow board, a perfect match.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='The museum call ends with a promise to check the trunk; Wren leaves her phone number and hopes.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='The train to Bellhaven breaks down in a storm; Wren reaches the museum after closing and presses her face to the cold glass.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='The chip on the ear matches the museum photo; Wren takes the rook to the tournament and wins the junior trophy.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='The donation ledger shows the Elm set came from a Yarrow estate; Wren copies every word into her notebook.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='The letter names Ada Bowe; Wren finds her grave in the old churchyard and leaves the fox rook beside the stone.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='The letter date solves the riddle; Mrs Harlow invites the whole family to the shop and they toast the extra piece.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='The cabinet has a gap where the fox rook belongs; Wren fits the piece into the row and the set is whole again.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='Mr Yarrow holds the rook and thanks Wren; he returns it to the family set and the story closes like a well made box.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='The collector blocks the back door and claims the piece; Wren calls for help but the shop lights go out.'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=70 beats='The museum puts the fox rook on display with a card that says carved by Tomas Bowe; Wren visits it every Saturday.'>>
